scripts.build: bun build --compile --outfile=bin/honden src/main.ts && bun build --compile --outfile=bin/honden-bot src/botmain.ts
scripts.build:core: cargo build --release --manifest-path core/watch/Cargo.toml && cargo build --release --manifest-path core/guard/Cargo.toml && cp core/watch/target/release/honden-watch bin/.honden-watch.new && mv -f bin/.honden-watch.new bin/honden-watch && cp core/guard/target/release/honden-parse bin/.honden-parse.new && mv -f bin/.honden-parse.new bin/honden-parse
scripts.build:all: bun run build && bun run build:core
